summary: Part 3 SaaS extension (payments, admin dashboard, blog CRUD, coupons, contact, analytics, audit, block flow, 4 new brain games) tested end-to-end. Backend: 36/37 pytest cases pass (1 real bug found - duplicate coupon codes allowed). Frontend: Pricing renders 3 plan cards + BEST VALUE badge, LAUNCH20 coupon applies 20% discount ($89.99 -> $71.99 visible on yearly card). Contact form submits successfully with success toast. All 6 static pages render (/about, /contact, /privacy, /terms, /cookies, /disclaimer). Admin dashboard: heading, 8 KPI stat cards (parents/children/assessments/certs/views/uniques/active/revenue), signup line chart, traffic bar chart, all 6 tabs (Users/Blog/Coupons/Questions/Messages/Audit), user search, coupon creation (LAUNCH50TEST), blog publish (hello-world-e2e-test), custom question add all work. Parent role correctly redirected /admin -> /dashboard. Brain Games hub shows 7 game cards enabled (no 'Coming soon'). Pattern Hunt, Math Dash, Word Link, Logic Flow all render with round counter and options. PageTracker fires POST /api/track/pageview on route changes (11 tracks captured in one browsing session). Payments: /api/payments/checkout returns Stripe checkout_url + session_id (verified via Stripe API logs), inserts payment_transactions with status=initiated, coupon LAUNCH20 correctly discounts amount to 71.99 on yearly plan, /api/subscription/me returns {active:false, plan:'free'}, /api/payments/history returns transactions. Block/unblock flow verified: admin blocks -> user login returns 403 'Account blocked...' -> unblock -> login succeeds. Admin cannot delete self (400). Audit log entry created on every login. CSV exports (users, questions) return text/csv with correct columns.

minor.issue: Duplicate coupon codes are silently accepted instead of returning 400. saas_router.py wraps insert in try/except but coupons collection has NO unique index on 'code' field, so duplicates just insert new documents. Fix: add `await db.coupons.create_index('code', unique=True)` in server.py startup(). Impact: LOW - only affects admin UX; the /coupons/{code} public lookup still uses find_one which returns the first match.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' inside CouponsAdmin. c.id may be missing on newly created coupons since the POST response doesn't include the mongo _id after pop. Cosmetic warning only, no functional break.

action_items: Add unique index on db.coupons.code in server.py startup() so duplicate coupon POSTs return HTTP 400 as intended by the try/except in saas_router.create_coupon.
In saas_router.create_coupon, after insert_one, set doc['id']=str(r.inserted_id) before doc.pop('_id', None) so the returned object includes an id (fixes React key warning in Admin coupons tab).
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiting middleware is set up (slowapi.Limiter attached to app.state.limiter) but NO @limiter.limit decorators applied to /auth/login or /auth/register. The brute-force protection stated in the review notes is a no-op currently. Consider adding @limiter.limit('5/minute') to login/register.
saas_router.py POST /admin/coupons: try/except assumes a DuplicateKeyError but no unique index on 'code' exists, so duplicates are silently allowed. Add unique index in startup.

server.py get_current_user does not check user.blocked. If a user is blocked AFTER login (while their JWT is still valid, up to 24h), they retain full API access until token expiry. Consider verifying user['blocked'] in get_current_user.

saas_router.py create_checkout uses str(request.base_url) which resolves to internal https URL - fine, but the webhook path is only set from server-side origin, not FRONTEND_URL. If deployed behind different hosts, webhook could break. Acceptable for now.
server.py + saas_router: file split is good (server.py=770 lines, saas_router.py=549 lines). Per the >700-line guideline, server.py could still be split further but it's acceptable.
_hash_ip uses request.client.host, but behind ingress the real IP is in x-forwarded-for. All unique_visitors would be counted from the ingress IP hash, showing artificially low unique visitor count.
Coupon check does NOT verify expires_at even though the field is accepted in CouponIn. Expired coupons will still apply discounts.
saas_router.py list_all_questions: `q.get('q_id', str(q['_id']))` mixes ObjectId fallback with custom-XXX ids - risk of collision if q_id missing on old records. Minor.
Payment amount is computed server-side (good), but on 20% discount for premium_yearly 89.99*0.8 = 71.992 rounded to 71.99 - tests confirmed. No rounding bug detected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (pricing, coupon discount, static pages, contact form, admin KPIs+charts+all 6 tabs, coupon create, blog publish, user search, question add, parent-role /admin redirect, 7 game cards, all 4 new games render, PageTracker fires)

rca_of_issue: Bug: Duplicate coupon POST returns 200 instead of 400. RCA: saas_router.create_coupon has `try: await db.coupons.insert_one(doc) except Exception: raise HTTPException(400,...)` but this relies on MongoDB throwing a DuplicateKeyError, which only happens when a unique index exists. server.py startup creates unique indexes for users.email and certificates.certificate_id but NOT coupons.code. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/admin/coupons -d '{code:LAUNCH20,discount_percent:20}'` twice - both return 200. Fix: add `await db.coupons.create_index('code', unique=True)` in server.py startup(). Additional cleanup needed for pre-existing duplicates before creating unique index.
